requestTimeSafetyNet.runtimeBehavior: No CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE or CREATE INDEX executes from request handlers.
requestTimeSafetyNet.startupGuard: verifySchemaOnce performs read-only information_schema table/column checks once per Worker isolate and returns 503 when required schema is unavailable.

assessment: VERIFIED - schema evolution is migration-first and request-time DDL/self-healing has been removed. A read-only startup guard fails clearly without changing schema.
failureBehavior: Migration or schema verification failure returns a clear 503 boundary; no destructive or opportunistic DDL is attempted.
ownerAction: Run ordered migrations before deployment with migrate.mjs; record the deployed migration commit and verify schema before routing traffic.
